list.title: Branches and terminals
list.text: Each branch is a place you sell from. Terminals are the counters inside it.
list.emptyText: Add your first branch to start selling. Its name and address appear on receipts.
list.limitTitle: You’ve used all {{count}} branches in your plan
list.limitText: Deactivate a branch or upgrade your plan to add another.
list.errorText: Check your connection and try again.

form.addText: Start with the basics. Advanced settings are kept separate below.
form.editText: Change the details, then save. Advanced settings are below.
form.codeHint: Short code for reports. Letters, numbers, - and _ only.
form.receiptHeaderHint: Printed at the top of every receipt from this branch.
form.receiptHeaderPlaceholder: Thank you for shopping with us!
form.mainText: Your head-office branch. Shown first in lists and reports.
form.negativeText: Let cashiers sell an item even when the system shows none left. Stock goes below zero until you correct it. Leave off unless you have a reason.
form.previewNote: The highlighted line is your receipt header.
form.fixOne: Fix 1 field to save this branch. Everything you typed is kept.
form.fixMany: Fix {{count}} fields to save this branch. Everything you typed is kept.
